slots.description: Direct application/json block stores flowchart nodes, tasks, and hints. Keyboard: the canvas is one tab stop. Arrow keys move between nodes; Enter adds the node to the path being selected, or edits its caption; `a` walks along the arrows of the node (Enter edits the arrow's caption); `c` starts a connection, the arrow keys pick the target and Enter creates it; Alt+arrows move the node (Alt+Shift for large steps); Shift+arrows pan; `+` and `-` zoom; `0` fits the chart; Escape cancels or clears the selection; Delete removes the selection. Touch: tap selects, drag moves, a long press opens the node menu, a double tap edits a caption, two fingers pan and zoom. Print: the whole chart is printed fitted to the page, without grid, controls and selection, followed by the task list. A chart without nodes prints a short note. Files and conversions: a Mermaid flowchart (`.mmd`) is imported and exported (lossy: positions, tasks, hints and colors are not part of Mermaid; on import the nodes are laid out in layers, subgraphs are refused, a second arrow between two nodes and arrows from a node to itself are dropped, and a recorded path of a task is cleared); the chart is exported as a PNG picture (`image/png`) or as an `img` element with a PNG data URL; an `ol` or `ul` becomes a chain of process steps between a start and an end, and the chart becomes an `ol` of its captions in reading order (branches and loops are flattened).
